title: Jar Jar Binks
subtitle: Galactic Republic
description: Jar jar Binks was a Gungan living on Naboo. Binks was prone to accidents and buffoonery, and as such was banned from his home city of Otoh Gunga. During the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo, Jar Jar stumbled upon Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi. Jinn was able to secure passage to Theed, taking Binks with him all the way to Tatooine, Coruscant and back to Naboo.
